title: Disjointness of lifted and auxiliary coordinates
statement: Let $n$, the number of clauses $c$, and the block size $b$ be natural numbers. Let a term on $n$ coordinates consist of a list of literals whose coordinate indices are pairwise distinct, and choose a clause index $k\in\text{Fin}(c)$. Extend each term literal to the first $n$ coordinates among $n+bc$ coordinates, and form the auxiliary literals for clause $k$ on its block of $b$ coordinates. The sets of coordinate indices in these two lists are disjoint.
hypotheses_covered: The term is a list of literals on $n$ coordinates with pairwise distinct indices
